messages:
adriana: kicking off EU quiet window for router traffic shift at 03:00 UTC. target: blue->green (v2.3.1). will follow phased weights: 5%,20%,50%,100%. ack please

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary v2.3.1 -> blue pool; build: r-2026-03-20-3168

jon: ack. I'll watch perf dashboards + traces. setting alert on 5xx spike.

maya: I'll pin session cookie routing for 10m after each weight bump to reduce migration noise. see snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/router/pin -d '{"session_cookie":"rw_sid","duration":600}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

sre-oncall: rollback criteria proposal: if 5xx rate > 2% absolute increase for 3m OR p50 latency > 200ms increase for 5m -> rollback to v2.3.0. any objections?

lucas: looks good. add error budget burn: if incident budget > 30% within 1h -> abort shift and pin back.

adriana: agreed + add canary smoke gate: synthetic test 1/1 must pass before next bump.

ops-bot: ACTION: apply weight 5% to green now -> `routerctl set-weight --route api --weights v2.3.1=5,v2.3.0=95`

deploy-bot: canary ping results: 200/200 OK, latency within baseline.

jon: metrics steady. no spike.

maya: pinned sessions for this cohort.

adriana: moving to 20% in 10m unless alerts. assigning rollback lead: @sre-oncall. release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1

sre-oncall: ack. preparing runbook: https://redwood.incidents/runbooks/rollback-v2.3

lucas: reminder: version pin on dedicated pools set to v2.3.1 after 100% shift. don't forget to bump autoscale profiles.

adriana: copy. postmortem tags: deployments, router, shift-window.

ops-bot: weight update scheduled at +10m -> 20%. dry-run=false

deploy-bot: deploy complete. monitor for 15m.

jon: minor spike in 95th at +6m -> 230ms, not breaching threshold. watching.

sre-oncall: still within headroom. hold.

adriana: bumping to 20% now.

ops-bot: applied -> `routerctl set-weight --route api --weights v2.3.1=20,v2.3.0=80`

deploy-bot: canary smoke: 48/50 ok, 2 transient errors (502) from edge layer.

maya: edge retries auto-resolved, no client errors.

jon: checking traces, root cause is transient connection reset at edge, not app. safe to continue.

adriana: proceeding to 50% in 15m. pinging infra for extra capacity: @lucas

lucas: scaling pool +2 nodes pre-warm.

sre-oncall: if errors cross thresholds during the next step, I will pin back to 0% and trigger rollback.

ops-bot: scheduled ramp to 50% in 15m.

deploy-bot: note: if we need emergency rollback, run: `deploy-bot rollback --to v2.3.0 --force` — will unroll traffic pins automatically.

adriana: thanks team. I'll update release notes with final traffic times once complete. :rocket:
